quests.correctAnswer: The cafe was so crowded that we decided to go somewhere else.
quests.hint: Start with 'The cafe'. Then the so-that result structure.
quests.explanation: 'So crowded that we decided'=a result structure. 'So+adjective+that'=consequence.

quests.correctAnswer: She had already finished dinner when her flatmate finally arrived home.
quests.hint: Begin with 'She'. Past perfect action, when+clause.
quests.explanation: 'Had already finished'=past perfect showing completion before another past action.

quests.correctAnswer: He worked overtime every evening because the project deadline was approaching quickly.
quests.hint: Start with 'He'. Action, time, reason because+clause.
quests.explanation: 'Because the project deadline was approaching'=reason clause.

quests.correctAnswer: The flight was delayed by two hours due to severe weather conditions.
quests.hint: Begin with 'The flight'. Passive, by how much, reason.
quests.explanation: Passive voice: 'was delayed by'. 'Due to severe weather conditions'=because of bad weather.

quests.correctAnswer: She not only passed the exam but also achieved the highest score in her class.
quests.hint: Start with 'She'. Two achievements with correlative conjunction.
quests.explanation: 'Not only... but also'=correlative conjunction adding a more impressive fact.

quests.correctAnswer: He had to cancel his holiday plans because of an unexpected work commitment.
quests.hint: Begin with 'He'. Obligation+action, reason with 'because of'.
quests.explanation: 'Had to cancel'=was obliged to. 'Because of an unexpected work commitment'.

quests.correctAnswer: The scientist published her findings in a leading international journal.
quests.hint: Start with 'The scientist'. Action, object, where.
quests.explanation: 'Published her findings'=made results available.

quests.correctAnswer: Although the film received mixed reviews it became a box office success.
quests.hint: Begin with 'Although'. Concession clause, then main clause.
quests.explanation: 'Although' shows contrast. 'Box office success'=made a lot of money.

quests.correctAnswer: He rebuilt his confidence gradually by taking small but consistent steps forward.
quests.hint: Start with 'He'. Action, adverb, by+gerund method.
quests.explanation: 'Gradually'=slowly over time. 'By taking small but consistent steps'=method.

quests.correctAnswer: The company introduced flexible working hours to improve employee satisfaction and productivity.
quests.hint: Begin with 'The company'. Action, purpose - two outcomes.
quests.explanation: 'Flexible working hours'=adjustable start/end times. 'To improve'=infinitive of purpose.

quests.correctAnswer: She read several reviews before choosing which restaurant to book for the celebration.
quests.hint: Start with 'She'. Action, then decision with embedded question.
quests.explanation: 'Before choosing which restaurant to book'='before+-ing'+'which+noun+infinitive'.

quests.correctAnswer: He spent most of his free time reading biographies of influential historical figures.
quests.hint: Begin with 'He'. Time-spending phrase, then what.
quests.explanation: 'Most of his free time'=the largest portion.

quests.correctAnswer: The engineering student won a prestigious scholarship to study at MIT.
quests.hint: Start with 'The engineering student'. Action, adjective+noun, purpose infinitive.
quests.explanation: 'Won a prestigious scholarship'=gained a highly respected award.

quests.correctAnswer: She contacted the landlord as soon as she noticed the leak in the ceiling.
quests.hint: Begin with 'She'. Action, as-soon-as+clause.
quests.explanation: 'As soon as'=immediately when.

quests.correctAnswer: He decided to take a break from social media for an entire month.
quests.hint: Start with 'He'. Decision+infinitive, from what, for how long.
quests.explanation: 'Take a break from'=stop temporarily.

quests.correctAnswer: The award-winning journalist interviewed several government officials about the new policy.
quests.hint: Begin with 'The award-winning journalist'. Action, whom, about what.
quests.explanation: 'Award-winning journalist'=hyphenated compound adjective.

quests.correctAnswer: She realised she had left her passport at the hotel when reaching the airport.
quests.hint: Start with 'She'. Realisation+clause with past perfect, when+clause.
quests.explanation: 'Realised she had left'=past simple+past perfect.

quests.correctAnswer: He presented a compelling argument that changed many people's opinions on the issue.
quests.hint: Begin with 'He'. Action, adjective+noun, relative clause.
quests.explanation: 'Compelling argument'=a very convincing case.

quests.correctAnswer: The unexpected power cut lasted for more than three hours during the storm.
quests.hint: Start with 'The unexpected power cut'. Duration, when.
quests.explanation: 'Lasted for more than three hours'='last for'+duration.

quests.correctAnswer: She volunteered to present at the conference despite feeling incredibly nervous.
quests.hint: Begin with 'She'. Action+infinitive, despite+gerund.
quests.explanation: 'Despite feeling incredibly nervous'='despite+-ing'. Shows courage.

quests.correctAnswer: He finally received the promotion he had been waiting for since the beginning of the year.
quests.hint: Start with 'He'. Time adverb, outcome, relative clause with past perfect continuous.
quests.explanation: 'Had been waiting for'=past perfect continuous showing ongoing past action.

quests.correctAnswer: The startup secured a significant round of funding from several venture capital investors.
quests.hint: Begin with 'The startup'. Action, adjective+noun phrase, from whom.
quests.explanation: 'Secured funding'=successfully obtained investment.

quests.correctAnswer: She completed her postgraduate degree while working full-time at a hospital.
quests.hint: Start with 'She'. Academic achievement, while+gerund.
quests.explanation: 'While working full-time'=at the same time as working.

quests.correctAnswer: He impressed his interviewers with his in-depth knowledge of the industry.
quests.hint: Begin with 'He'. Action, with what.
quests.explanation: 'Impressed with'=caused a strong positive impression.

quests.correctAnswer: The renovation project transformed the old warehouse into a modern art gallery.
quests.hint: Start with 'The renovation project'. Action, from old to new.
quests.explanation: 'Transformed into'=completely changed from one thing to another.

quests.correctAnswer: She took comprehensive notes during the lecture and shared them with her classmates.
quests.hint: Begin with 'She'. Two actions, adjective+noun, with whom.
quests.explanation: 'Comprehensive notes'=complete notes. 'Shared with'=gave to others to use.

quests.correctAnswer: He struggled to keep up with the pace of the advanced conversation class.
quests.hint: Start with 'He'. Action+infinitive, then what.
quests.explanation: 'Struggled to keep up with'=found it hard to maintain the same speed.

quests.correctAnswer: The innovative company developed a revolutionary product that disrupted the entire market.
quests.hint: Begin with 'The innovative company'. Action, adjective+noun, relative clause.
quests.explanation: 'Revolutionary product'=something completely new.

quests.correctAnswer: She balanced her demanding career with her responsibilities as a parent.
quests.hint: Start with 'She'. Action, adjective+noun, with what.
quests.explanation: 'Balanced with'=maintained equal attention to two things.

quests.correctAnswer: He could not sleep the night before his big presentation despite feeling exhausted.
quests.hint: Begin with 'He'. Inability, when, despite+gerund.
quests.explanation: 'Despite feeling exhausted'='despite+-ing' shows unexpected contrast.
